newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Chelyabenergo says 1996 profit doubled.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Chelyabenergo says 1996 profit doubled.

text.p: NOTE - Full name AO Energetiki i Elektrifikatsii Chelyabenergo.
Earlier this month the company estimated pre-tax profit at 920 billion roubles after 490 billion.

Assistant economics director Nikolai Shchapin said profit figure based on all deliveries, including those to customers who have not yet paid. Profits from sales which have been paid for totaled 684.2 billion roubles.
National power company UES owns 58 percent of Chelyabenergo and the Chelyabinsk region property fund owns a further 15.7 percent.

These figures are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
